option_relations.rationale: Stage IIIC melanoma with satellite metastases is a broader classification that includes melanoma with in-transit metastases, as satellite lesions are a form of in-transit metastases.
Recurrent melanoma is a broader category that can include melanoma with in-transit metastases if the in-transit metastases represent a recurrence.
Persistent or recurrent metastatic melanoma is a broader category that can include melanoma with in-transit metastases if the in-transit metastases are considered metastatic and persistent/recurrent.
Metastatic Melanoma is a broader category that includes melanoma with in-transit metastases, as in-transit metastases are a form of regional metastasis.
